limitations: Live acceptance covers one user installation/relaunch and the recorded Browser and Computer Use interactions; repeated reconnect stability and real-phone behavior were not tested.
Earlier concurrent archive loading hit ENOMEM; initial broad native fixtures stalled. Recorded acceptance uses sequential reruns.
The app copy loses the original executable signature; official installation is retained.

liveAcceptance.context: User-installed and relaunched patched Windows desktop with WSL backend; both installed recovery modules matched reviewed source.

browser.scenario: Connect through supported client, open Example Domain, inspect accessibility state, click Learn more, verify IANA Example Domains destination and close temporary tab.

computerUse.scenario: Discover Windows apps, launch installed Notepad, select returned window, capture state, click text editor, type harmless test sentence and verify document text and screenshot.
computerUse.recovery: Initial click geometry unavailable; refreshed and activated window with screenshot-backed state, then retried successfully.
computerUse.notAccepted: Calculator launch exposed no targetable window; no Calculator interaction was accepted.

independentReview.scope: Source excerpts, final patch strings, failure recovery, permissions, generation cache, native helper and publisher semantics; no live desktop acceptance.
